items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: I joined Lena, first, Arnold Ross was the pianist.

ctx.x: See, I joined Lena, first, Arnold Ross was the pianist. Then he left and Luther Henderson took his place. So I wanted to meet Joe. I went over and introduced myself to him. But I didn't know he was a bass player. You know, I thought maybe he was an arranger or just a copyist, you know. So he commented, he said, 'You play some good bass, man.' He said, 'I play bass, too.' And he was sort of stuttering, like, you know? I thought maybe he didn't stutter, but he was kind of excited or something. We come to find out…
